Name: Integrated Wildlife
Author: w8AwA8w
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/xJs2PBV.png[/img]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=4]Make the world of Stardew Valley feel lived in, find animals under rocks, in the soil, in the grass, in the tree tops. This mod adds 36 new integrated catchable wild animals, from critters to fluffy mammals and reptiles using Nature In The Valley.

Integrated Wildlife adds 36 creatures to your game, gotten from over 18 different interactions. Some rare, some common. Most creatures will spawn when you the farmer uncover them. From cutting grass, clearing weeds, digging in the mines and checking garbage cans to panning for ore and foraging, you can find animals in all sorts of places!

[/size][size=4]These animals can be caught using the net tool, sold at the Insectarium (accessed via bus), Joja's and Pierre's. This mod also adds a new feature which allows you to catch creatures using fishing rods. After catching, these cuties can be donated to the insectarium, released into the wild, added to terrariums, etc.

A full list of creatures and how to get them can be found at the bottom of this page.

Note: The Cave Scorpion is aggressive and deals damage. The coconut crab and rusty tussock caterpillar are not aggressive but also deal damage.

Don't forget to endorse this mod if you enjoy it ^^

Made by xAncAx and AwA

[/size][/color][color=#d0e0e3][size=6][b]Configuration
[/b][/size][/color][color=#d0e0e3][size=4]This mod contains two config files, one "WildlifeExpandedContent" has a single option, which allows you to disable the inclusion of mammals and (a) bird as findable/catchable creatures. The other config file "WildlifeExpanded" has many options, one option per "uncovering" method. These options allow you to customize the chance of getting creatures from each "uncovering" method (like cutting grass for example)

There are also options for the behavior of dangerous creatures, whether to leave them dangerous or make them safe, or remove them entirely.

[/size][/color][color=#d0e0e3][size=6][b]Translations[/b]
[/size][/color][color=#d0e0e3][size=4]This mod contains two translatable i18n files. If you'd like to you can send me a translated version of the i18n file in your native language and I will add it to the main file, and give you credit for the translation here. You may also reupload translation files on separate pages, with a dependency on this mod. I will give credit to translators below.

Thankyou to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/121177218-capmita/]CapMita[/url] for the Chinese translation of this mod!﻿

Thankyou to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/160938118-letsynata/]Letsynata[/url]﻿ for the Russian translation of this mod!

Thankyou to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/185298582-airbench/]Airbench[/url] for the Turkish translation of this mod!﻿


[color=#d0e0e3][size=6][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size][/color]This mod is compatible with SVE, SCA, all other expansions. There are no known un-compatibilities, though if you find any please make a comment and let me know.[/size]
